_note: Film finish: Khronos PBR Neutral, comp saturation 1.4, black point 0.003 and luma contrast 1.12 (post_grade), world gain 0 with the film's blue ambient. Exposure -0.9 (film -0.95): the web has no volume in-scatter or DOF bloom, so mid thirds ran 7-14 percent dark at -0.95. Bloom 0.2 / 0.3 / 1.4: the kit-proportional 0.085 / 0.7 put a warm veil over the window sky (top +15 percent at 1 and 4 s); a tighter kernel with more strength keeps the glow round the windows. Spot budget 16 and priorities: BlueFill's stand-in (priority 40 in the glb) and the teddy's rims take 3 slots all film, BearCool / BearWarm / PillowWash light the teddy's face and DollUp / DollSpill the dollhouse facade at 1-4 s. MoonSun specular 0.3: in Blender it is light-linked off the floor, and at full specular it lays a wide cool highlight on the floor in the bottom corners. BearRim specular 0.3: at grazing angles the 145 kW rim stand-ins drew white outlines round the muzzle and ears. The floor mirror comes from the Floor's mirror_strength / mirror_streak extras.
